newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Planting keeps sales slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Planting keeps sales slow.

text.p: Active spring wheat and barley planting, rather than sharply lower cash wheat bids, kept cash wheat sales light in the northern Plains and Pacific Northwest wheat markets Monday, dealers said.
Minneapolis dealers said wheat sales had been slow prior to Monday's drop in the markets. "It worse now with the board down," a Minneapolis dealer said.
Planting was under way in nearly all areas except the Red River Valley, where wet fields delayed sowing.
"Out here they are busy putting in spring wheat and barley," a Montana dealer said.
